desc: Quests (Quest shop quests ids 1..187 and resident request quests ids 2000..9502). Each row: title, 5 description lines, client name, prerequisites (up to 4 quest ids + up to 4 FlagList flags), one objective (cond_type + up to 3 targets/counts + option), one reward (reward_type/value/count), optional stage unlock (dungeon.stage_key) and optional extra enemies (QuestEnemy group). Recruiting: reward_type 5 = unique character joins (value=char.dat id: 250 Logan, 280 Erynder Z, 300 Drumdawn, 310 Brave), reward_type 6 = unlocks a class for creation (value = class base char id, e.g. 1090 Thief, 1230 Asagi, 2020 Imp).

fields.name: id
fields.desc: quest id (1..187 quest-shop quests, 2000..9502 resident requests); unique

enum.0: defeat N enemies of class (target=class base id, -1=any; option 1 = min enemy level)
enum.1: defeat N of a specific character (target=char.dat id incl. rank, e.g. Item God 4990)
enum.2: obtain/bring item (target=item.dat id or -1; option 3=rarity?,4=item level,5/6=item category (label text),7=elemental weapon)
enum.4: clear stage (target=map id = dungeon.map_id; option 10 = extra rule)
enum.6: reach level (target=char.dat id / class id, count=level)

fields.name: group_major
fields.desc: request quests: 1..7 = thousands digit-1 of id (9xxx use 0); 0 for shop quests

fields.name: group_minor
fields.desc: request quests: 1..8 sub-group (roughly hundreds digit+1 / requester group); 0 for shop quests

fields.name: prereq_quest1
fields.desc: quest id that must be completed first (0 = none); e.g. Ninja rep needs quest 5, Pirate needs 6+7

fields.name: prereq_quest2
fields.desc: quest id that must be completed first (0 = none); e.g. Ninja rep needs quest 5, Pirate needs 6+7

fields.name: prereq_quest3
fields.desc: quest id that must be completed first (0 = none); e.g. Ninja rep needs quest 5, Pirate needs 6+7

fields.name: prereq_quest4
fields.desc: quest id that must be completed first (0 = none); e.g. Ninja rep needs quest 5, Pirate needs 6+7

fields.name: req_flag1
fields.desc: FlagListDataBase id that must be set (e.g. 299 FLAG_SCENARIO_02_CLEAR, 1699 post-game, 14018 FLAG_FACILITY_SHURA_WORLD, 1712 after-Asagi)

fields.name: req_flag2
fields.desc: FlagListDataBase id that must be set (e.g. 299 FLAG_SCENARIO_02_CLEAR, 1699 post-game, 14018 FLAG_FACILITY_SHURA_WORLD, 1712 after-Asagi)

fields.name: req_flag3
fields.desc: FlagListDataBase id that must be set (e.g. 299 FLAG_SCENARIO_02_CLEAR, 1699 post-game, 14018 FLAG_FACILITY_SHURA_WORLD, 1712 after-Asagi)

fields.name: req_flag4
fields.desc: FlagListDataBase id that must be set (e.g. 299 FLAG_SCENARIO_02_CLEAR, 1699 post-game, 14018 FLAG_FACILITY_SHURA_WORLD, 1712 after-Asagi)

fields.name: req_extra
fields.desc: 0 normally; 100 for the six story "Trial" challenge quests (157,158,164,166,169,170); 16009 (=FLAG_WISH_COSTOM_COLOR_EDIT, same as its reward flag) for quest 187 -> probably a flag that must NOT be set / extra requirement

fields.name: important
fields.desc: 1 for quests 2..50 and 187 (overlord recruit, class unlock, key quests), else 0; probably highlight/notification

fields.name: sort_order
fields.desc: progress slot: the save keeps each quest's completed/accepted/seen state at this index, and lists are built in slot order. Must be unique; Quest-shop quests (id < 2000) must also be below the number of quests or the board never shows them (vanilla shop quests use id - 1; free vanilla slots: 396, 397, 429). The installer fixes bad values

fields.name: client_JP
fields.desc: requester name/title, e.g. "Thief Rep, Colette" (JP right-aligned with U+3000)

fields.name: cond_target1
fields.desc: objective target; meaning depends on cond_type (class id / char id / item id / map id / stat index / weapon type / FLAG_CHARAMAKE flag); -1 = any

fields.name: cond_target2
fields.desc: objective target; meaning depends on cond_type (class id / char id / item id / map id / stat index / weapon type / FLAG_CHARAMAKE flag); -1 = any

fields.name: cond_target3
fields.desc: objective target; meaning depends on cond_type (class id / char id / item id / map id / stat index / weapon type / FLAG_CHARAMAKE flag); -1 = any

fields.name: cond_option
fields.desc: extra condition kind: 0 none, 1 min enemy level (cond 0), 3 rarity?, 4 item level, 5 item category (label shown in cond_label), 6 category+rank, 7 elemental weapon, 10 stage rule, 11 research, 12 color edit, 2056 (quest 34)

fields.name: cond_option_value
fields.desc: parameter of cond_option (e.g. min level 10..1000, item level 10..100)

fields.name: cond_label2_JP
fields.desc: unused label slot for target 2 (always empty)

fields.name: cond_label3_JP
fields.desc: unused label slot for target 3 (always empty)

enum.6: class unlocked for creation (value=char.dat class base id)

fields.name: reward_value
fields.desc: depends on reward_type: HL amount / item.dat id / Skill.dat id / magic.dat id / char.dat id / class id / Chara World rank / FlagList id

fields.name: unlock_stage
fields.desc: dungeon.dat stage_key made available by the quest (e.g. 5018 "Overlord of Revenge" for quest 2); 0 none

fields.name: unlock_stage2
fields.desc: second stage_key (equal to unlock_stage for Challenge/Carnage stages, 0 for Overlord fights and "Trial" quests) - likely the stage kept after completion

fields.name: quest_enemy_group
fields.desc: QuestEnemy.dat group whose units are added to the cond_target map (verified: 15 quests, group maps == cond_target1)

fields.name: difficulty
fields.desc: 1..10, grows with quest difficulty (overlord fights 2,3,5,7; class unlocks 2..8); probably star rank shown in list
